(* ============================================================================================== *)
(* SECTION 1: TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) PRESSURE VOTING & SENSOR HEALTH DIAGNOSTICS   *)
(* ============================================================================================== *)
(*
  The abyssal glider relies entirely on its hydrostatic pressure measurement for depth control,
  crush-depth envelope enforcement, and apogee turnaround timing. A single erroneous pressure
  reading could cause premature surfacing or catastrophic hull implosion at > 6,000 m.
  Here, three resonant quartz sensors (A, B, C) are monitored using strict 2oo3 TMR voting logic.
*)

(* 1.1 Sensor Frozen Value Detection (Resonant quartz output should exhibit acoustic micro-dither) *)
IF ABS(rPressureSensor_A_bar - rSensorA_Prev_bar) < 0.0005 THEN
    iSensorA_FreezeCount := iSensorA_FreezeCount + 1;
ELSE
    iSensorA_FreezeCount := 0;
END_IF;
rSensorA_Prev_bar := rPressureSensor_A_bar;

IF ABS(rPressureSensor_B_bar - rSensorB_Prev_bar) < 0.0005 THEN
    iSensorB_FreezeCount := iSensorB_FreezeCount + 1;
ELSE
    iSensorB_FreezeCount := 0;
END_IF;
rSensorB_Prev_bar := rPressureSensor_B_bar;

IF ABS(rPressureSensor_C_bar - rSensorC_Prev_bar) < 0.0005 THEN
    iSensorC_FreezeCount := iSensorC_FreezeCount + 1;
ELSE
    iSensorC_FreezeCount := 0;
END_IF;
rSensorC_Prev_bar := rPressureSensor_C_bar;

(* Mark sensor as invalid if frozen for more than 50 consecutive cycles (5.0 seconds) *)
IF iSensorA_FreezeCount > 50 THEN
    bSensorA_Valid := FALSE;
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0001; (* Sensor A Frozen Warning *)
END_IF;

IF iSensorB_FreezeCount > 50 THEN
    bSensorB_Valid := FALSE;
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0002; (* Sensor B Frozen Warning *)
END_IF;

IF iSensorC_FreezeCount > 50 THEN
    bSensorC_Valid := FALSE;
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0004; (* Sensor C Frozen Warning *)
END_IF;

(* 1.2 Physical Range Checks: 0.0 bar (surface) to 660.0 bar (10% beyond nominal 6,000m depth) *)
IF (rPressureSensor_A_bar < -0.5) OR (rPressureSensor_A_bar > 660.0) THEN
    bSensorA_Valid := FALSE;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Sensor A Out of Range *)
END_IF;

IF (rPressureSensor_B_bar < -0.5) OR (rPressureSensor_B_bar > 660.0) THEN
    bSensorB_Valid := FALSE;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Sensor B Out of Range *)
END_IF;

IF (rPressureSensor_C_bar < -0.5) OR (rPressureSensor_C_bar > 660.0) THEN
    bSensorC_Valid := FALSE;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Sensor C Out of Range *)
END_IF;

(* 1.3 Pairwise Deviation Matrix Computation *)
rDevAB_bar := ABS(rPressureSensor_A_bar - rPressureSensor_B_bar);
rDevBC_bar := ABS(rPressureSensor_B_bar - rPressureSensor_C_bar);
rDevCA_bar := ABS(rPressureSensor_C_bar - rPressureSensor_A_bar);

(* Cross-channel deviation threshold = 2.5 bar (~25 meters depth discrepancy) *)
IF (rDevAB_bar > 2.5) OR (rDevBC_bar > 2.5) OR (rDevCA_bar > 2.5) THEN
    tSensorDiscrepancyTimer_s := tSensorDiscrepancyTimer_s + rCycleTime_s;
    IF tSensorDiscrepancyTimer_s > 2.0 THEN
        dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0008; (* Pressure Sensor Discrepancy Active *)
        (* Isolate the anomalous channel via majority deviation analysis *)
        IF (rDevAB_bar > 2.5) AND (rDevCA_bar > 2.5) THEN
            bSensorA_Valid := FALSE; (* Sensor A deviates from both B and C *)
        ELSIF (rDevAB_bar > 2.5) AND (rDevBC_bar > 2.5) THEN
            bSensorB_Valid := FALSE; (* Sensor B deviates from both A and C *)
        ELSIF (rDevBC_bar > 2.5) AND (rDevCA_bar > 2.5) THEN
            bSensorC_Valid := FALSE; (* Sensor C deviates from both A and B *)
        END_IF;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    tSensorDiscrepancyTimer_s := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Count remaining valid pressure transmitters *)
iValidPressureSensorCount := 0;
IF bSensorA_Valid THEN iValidPressureSensorCount := iValidPressureSensorCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bSensorB_Valid THEN iValidPressureSensorCount := iValidPressureSensorCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bSensorC_Valid THEN iValidPressureSensorCount := iValidPressureSensorCount + 1; END_IF;

(* 1.4 Median / Average Voting Arbitration *)
IF iValidPressureSensorCount = 3 THEN
    (* Full 2oo3 Median Voter: middle value of the three channels *)
    IF ((rPressureSensor_A_bar >= rPressureSensor_B_bar) AND (rPressureSensor_A_bar <= rPressureSensor_C_bar)) OR
       ((rPressureSensor_A_bar >= rPressureSensor_C_bar) AND (rPressureSensor_A_bar <= rPressureSensor_B_bar)) THEN
        rVotedPressure_bar := rPressureSensor_A_bar;
    ELSIF ((rPressureSensor_B_bar >= rPressureSensor_A_bar) AND (rPressureSensor_B_bar <= rPressureSensor_C_bar)) OR
          ((rPressureSensor_B_bar >= rPressureSensor_C_bar) AND (rPressureSensor_B_bar <= rPressureSensor_A_bar)) THEN
        rVotedPressure_bar := rPressureSensor_B_bar;
    ELSE
        rVotedPressure_bar := rPressureSensor_C_bar;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iValidPressureSensorCount = 2 THEN
    (* Dual-channel degraded mode: arithmetic mean of the two healthy channels *)
    IF bSensorA_Valid AND bSensorB_Valid THEN
        rVotedPressure_bar := (rPressureSensor_A_bar + rPressureSensor_B_bar) * 0.5;
    ELSIF bSensorB_Valid AND bSensorC_Valid THEN
        rVotedPressure_bar := (rPressureSensor_B_bar + rPressureSensor_C_bar) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rVotedPressure_bar := (rPressureSensor_A_bar + rPressureSensor_C_bar) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0010; (* Dual-channel Degraded Pressure Mode *)
ELSIF iValidPressureSensorCount = 1 THEN
    (* Single-channel fallback: route available healthy transmitter with critical advisory *)
    IF bSensorA_Valid THEN
        rVotedPressure_bar := rPressureSensor_A_bar;
    ELSIF bSensorB_Valid THEN
        rVotedPressure_bar := rPressureSensor_B_bar;
    ELSE
        rVotedPressure_bar := rPressureSensor_C_bar;
    END_IF;
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0020; (* Single-channel Critical Fallback Mode *)
ELSE
    (* Total TMR Sensor Failure: all three transmitters rejected *)
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Total Loss of Hydrostatic Pressure Telemetry *)
    bEmergencyAscentTriggered := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* 1.5 Slew-Rate Physical Sanity Check (Max vertical glider dive/climb rate is 0.6 m/s => 0.06 bar/s) *)
IF rVotedPressurePrev_bar > 0.0 THEN
    IF ABS(rVotedPressure_bar - rVotedPressurePrev_bar) > (0.50 * rCycleTime_s) THEN
        dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0040; (* Excessive Pressure Slew Rate Detected *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;
rVotedPressurePrev_bar := rVotedPressure_bar;


(* ============================================================================================== *)
(* SECTION 2: TEOS-10 / UNESCO SEAWATER DENSITY & HULL COMPRESSION HYDROSTATIC ESTIMATION         *)
(* ============================================================================================== *)
(*
  Seawater density rho(S, T, P) increases significantly with depth down to 6,000 meters.
  At the same time, the titanium/carbon-fiber pressure hull compresses under 600 bar external load.
  Exact net buoyancy requires online thermodynamic modeling via the UNESCO 1980 Equation of State.
*)

(* 2.1 Salinity Estimation via PSS-78 Practical Salinity Polynomial Approximation *)
(* Standard oceanographic conductivity ratio R = C(S,T,P) / C(35,15,0) where C(35,15,0) = 42.914 mS/cm *)
IF rCTD_Conductivity_mScm > 1.0 THEN
    rSalinity_PSU := (rCTD_Conductivity_mScm / 42.914) * 35.0 + 
                     (rCTD_Temperature_degC - 15.0) * 0.085;
    (* Clamp salinity to realistic oceanic boundaries *)
    IF rSalinity_PSU < 25.0 THEN rSalinity_PSU := 25.0; END_IF;
    IF rSalinity_PSU > 42.0 THEN rSalinity_PSU := 42.0; END_IF;
ELSE
    rSalinity_PSU := 34.85; (* Standard open-ocean deep water salinity fallback [PSU] *)
END_IF;

(* 2.2 Standard Atmospheric Pressure Density of Pure Water rho_w(T, 0) *)
(* Biggs 1967 polynomial as adopted in UNESCO 1980 *)
rDens_PureWater_0bar := 999.842594 + 
                        (0.06793952 * rCTD_Temperature_degC) - 
                        (0.009095290 * rCTD_Temperature_degC * rCTD_Temperature_degC) + 
                        (0.0001001685 * rCTD_Temperature_degC * rCTD_Temperature_degC * rCTD_Temperature_degC) - 
                        (0.000001120083 * rCTD_Temperature_degC * rCTD_Temperature_degC * rCTD_Temperature_degC * rCTD_Temperature_degC);

(* 2.3 Atmospheric Pressure Seawater Density rho(S, T, 0) *)
rDens_Seawater_0bar := rDens_PureWater_0bar + 
                       rSalinity_PSU * (0.824493 - (0.0040899 * rCTD_Temperature_degC) + 
                                        (0.000076438 * rCTD_Temperature_degC * rCTD_Temperature_degC) - 
                                        (0.00000082467 * rCTD_Temperature_degC * rCTD_Temperature_degC * rCTD_Temperature_degC)) + 
                       (rSalinity_PSU * SQRT(rSalinity_PSU)) * (-0.00572466 + (0.00010227 * rCTD_Temperature_degC)) + 
                       (rSalinity_PSU * rSalinity_PSU) * 0.00048314;

(* 2.4 High-Pressure Secant Bulk Modulus K(S, T, P) [bar] *)
(* Atmospheric term K(S, T, 0) *)
rK_0bar := 19652.21 + (148.4206 * rCTD_Temperature_degC) - 
           (2.327105 * rCTD_Temperature_degC * rCTD_Temperature_degC) + 
           (0.01360477 * rCTD_Temperature_degC * rCTD_Temperature_degC * rCTD_Temperature_degC) + 
           rSalinity_PSU * (54.6746 - (0.603459 * rCTD_Temperature_degC) + (0.0109987 * rCTD_Temperature_degC * rCTD_Temperature_degC)) + 
           (rSalinity_PSU * SQRT(rSalinity_PSU)) * (0.07944 + (0.016483 * rCTD_Temperature_degC));

(* Pressure correction terms for bulk modulus *)
rK_pressure_term := rVotedPressure_bar * (3.239908 + (0.00143713 * rCTD_Temperature_degC) + 
                                         rSalinity_PSU * (0.0022838 - (0.000010981 * rCTD_Temperature_degC))) + 
                    (rVotedPressure_bar * rVotedPressure_bar) * (0.0000850935 - (0.00000612293 * rCTD_Temperature_degC));

rSecantBulkModulus_K := rK_0bar + rK_pressure_term;

(* 2.5 In-Situ Seawater Density rho(S, T, P) *)
IF rSecantBulkModulus_K > rVotedPressure_bar THEN
    rSeawaterInSituDensity_kgm3 := rDens_Seawater_0bar / (1.0 - (rVotedPressure_bar / rSecantBulkModulus_K));
ELSE
    rSeawaterInSituDensity_kgm3 := 1054.5; (* Abyssal saturation clamp *)
END_IF;

(* 2.6 Depth Calculation from Hydrostatic Pressure (Saunders & Fofonoff 1976 Formulation) *)
(* Conversion factor: ~0.1008 bar per meter depth in deep abyssal ocean *)
rEstimatedDepth_m := (rVotedPressure_bar * 1.0E5) / (rSeawaterInSituDensity_kgm3 * c_StandardGravity_ms2);

(* 2.7 Pressure Hull Elastic Volumetric Compression & Thermal Shrinkage *)
(* Under 600 bar, the carbon/titanium hull shrinks by over 160 cm3, reducing displacement *)
rHullCompressionVolume_cm3 := c_GliderHullBaselineVol_cm3 * 
                              (c_HullCompressibility_perbar * rVotedPressure_bar - 
                               c_HullThermalCoeff_perdegC * (20.0 - rCTD_Temperature_degC));

(* 2.8 Variable Buoyancy Engine (VBE) Displaced Volume *)
(* Piston displacement [mm] into area [cm2] produces external bladder expansion [cm3] *)
rVBE_DisplacedVolume_cm3 := c_VBE_PistonArea_cm2 * (rHydraulicPistonPos_mm * 0.10);

(* 2.9 Real-Time Net Buoyant Force Estimation [Newtons] *)
(* F_net = g * [rho_sw * (V_hull_nominal - V_hull_compression + V_VBE) * 1e-6 - M_dry] *)
rEstimatedNetBuoyancy_N := c_StandardGravity_ms2 * 
                           ((rSeawaterInSituDensity_kgm3 * 
                             (c_GliderHullBaselineVol_cm3 - rHullCompressionVolume_cm3 + rVBE_DisplacedVolume_cm3) * 1.0E-6) - 
                            c_GliderDryMass_kg);


(* ============================================================================================== *)
(* SECTION 3: ACOUSTIC DVL NAVIGATION, EULER KINEMATICS & DEAD-RECKONING                           *)
(* ============================================================================================== *)
(*
  Translates body-fixed velocity vectors (u, v, w) into the Earth-referenced North-East-Down (NED)
  navigation frame using the 3D Direction Cosine Matrix (DCM).
  Maintains active estimates of deep ocean current drift and tracks dead-reckoning position.
*)

(* 3.1 Angle Conversions to Radians *)
rRadPitch := rIMU_Pitch_deg * 0.0174532925;
rRadRoll := rIMU_Roll_deg * 0.0174532925;
rRadHeading := rIMU_Heading_deg * 0.0174532925;

(* 3.2 Trigonometric Functions *)
rSinPitch := SIN(rRadPitch);
rCosPitch := COS(rRadPitch);
rSinRoll := SIN(rRadRoll);
rCosRoll := COS(rRadRoll);
rSinHeading := SIN(rRadHeading);
rCosHeading := COS(rRadHeading);

(* 3.3 3x3 Direction Cosine Rotation Matrix (Body to NED Earth Frame) *)
(* Row 1: North component *)
rDCM_11 := rCosPitch * rCosHeading;
rDCM_12 := (rSinRoll * rSinPitch * rCosHeading) - (rCosRoll * rSinHeading);
rDCM_13 := (rCosRoll * rSinPitch * rCosHeading) + (rSinRoll * rSinHeading);

(* Row 2: East component *)
rDCM_21 := rCosPitch * rSinHeading;
rDCM_22 := (rSinRoll * rSinPitch * rSinHeading) + (rCosRoll * rCosHeading);
rDCM_23 := (rCosRoll * rSinPitch * rSinHeading) - (rSinRoll * rCosHeading);

(* Row 3: Down component *)
rDCM_31 := -rSinPitch;
rDCM_32 := rSinRoll * rCosPitch;
rDCM_33 := rCosRoll * rCosPitch;

(* 3.4 Velocity Transformation & Navigation Fusion *)
IF bDVL_BottomLock AND bDVL_DataValid THEN
    (* DVL Ground-Track Mode: Transform measured bottom velocities into NED frame *)
    rVelNorth_ms := (rDCM_11 * rDVL_VelX_ms) + (rDCM_12 * rDVL_VelY_ms) + (rDCM_13 * rDVL_VelZ_ms);
    rVelEast_ms := (rDCM_21 * rDVL_VelX_ms) + (rDCM_22 * rDVL_VelY_ms) + (rDCM_23 * rDVL_VelZ_ms);
    rVelDown_ms := (rDCM_31 * rDVL_VelX_ms) + (rDCM_32 * rDVL_VelY_ms) + (rDCM_33 * rDVL_VelZ_ms);
    rDVL_LossTimer_s := 0.0;
    dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0001; (* DVL Bottom Lock Established *)

    (* Deep Ocean Current Drift Estimation: difference between ground speed and water-relative glide *)
    rOceanCurrentNorth_ms := rOceanCurrentNorth_ms + 
                             rCurrentEstWeight * (rVelNorth_ms - (rCosPitch * rCosHeading * rEstimatedSpeedThroughWater_ms) - rOceanCurrentNorth_ms);
    rOceanCurrentEast_ms := rOceanCurrentEast_ms + 
                            rCurrentEstWeight * (rVelEast_ms - (rCosPitch * rSinHeading * rEstimatedSpeedThroughWater_ms) - rOceanCurrentEast_ms);
ELSE
    (* Dead-Reckoning Fallback: Hydrodynamic Flight Dynamic Model *)
    rDVL_LossTimer_s := rDVL_LossTimer_s + rCycleTime_s;
    dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord AND 16#FFFF_FFFE; (* Clear DVL Bottom Lock Status *)

    (* Compute hydrodynamic glide airspeed from net buoyancy and pitch angle *)
    IF ABS(rEstimatedNetBuoyancy_N) > 0.5 THEN
        (* Steady glide speed formula: U = sqrt( (2 * |F_net| * sin(gamma)) / (rho * S_w * C_D) ) *)
        rEstimatedSpeedThroughWater_ms := SQRT((2.0 * ABS(rEstimatedNetBuoyancy_N) * ABS(rSinPitch)) / 
                                              (rSeawaterInSituDensity_kgm3 * c_WingArea_m2 * c_ParasiticDrag_CD0));
        IF rEstimatedSpeedThroughWater_ms > 0.85 THEN rEstimatedSpeedThroughWater_ms := 0.85; END_IF;
    ELSE
        rEstimatedSpeedThroughWater_ms := 0.05;
    END_IF;

    (* Estimate angle of attack alpha based on steady glide polar *)
    rEstimatedAngleOfAttack_deg := (c_WingArea_m2 * c_LiftSlope_perdeg);

    (* Synthesize velocities via dead-reckoning + estimated current drift *)
    rVelNorth_ms := (rCosPitch * rCosHeading * rEstimatedSpeedThroughWater_ms) + rOceanCurrentNorth_ms;
    rVelEast_ms := (rCosPitch * rSinHeading * rEstimatedSpeedThroughWater_ms) + rOceanCurrentEast_ms;
    rVelDown_ms := (-rSinPitch * rEstimatedSpeedThroughWater_ms);
END_IF;

(* 3.5 Numerical Integration of Coordinates [m] *)
rNavPositionNorth_m := rNavPositionNorth_m + (rVelNorth_ms * rCycleTime_s);
rNavPositionEast_m := rNavPositionEast_m + (rVelEast_ms * rCycleTime_s);
rEstimatedDescentRate_ms := rVelDown_ms;

(* ============================================================================================== *)
(* SECTION 4: 6-STATE DISCRETE STATE-SPACE LONGITUDINAL GLIDER FLIGHT MODEL                      *)
(* ============================================================================================== *)
(*
  Governs coupled longitudinal heave-pitch dynamics during abyssal glide:
  States: x = [w (m/s), q (rad/s), theta (rad), z (m), V_vbe (m3), x_mass (m)]^T
  Inputs: u = [Q_pump (m3/s), v_mass (m/s)]^T
  Outputs: y = [z (m), theta (rad), w (m/s), gamma (rad)]^T

  Linearized discrete-time matrices derived for U_nominal = 0.35 m/s at 6,000m depth, dT = 0.100s.
*)

IF NOT bMatricesInitialized THEN
    (* Row 1: Heave velocity dynamics (w) *)
    A_mat[1, 1] := 0.9650;  A_mat[1, 2] := 0.0320;  A_mat[1, 3] := -0.0981; A_mat[1, 4] := 0.0000;  A_mat[1, 5] := 1.250E2;  A_mat[1, 6] := -0.0520;
    (* Row 2: Pitch angular rate dynamics (q) *)
    A_mat[2, 1] := 0.0450;  A_mat[2, 2] := 0.9420;  A_mat[2, 3] := -0.1850; A_mat[2, 4] := 0.0000;  A_mat[2, 5] := 0.0000;   A_mat[2, 6] := 2.450E1;
    (* Row 3: Pitch angle kinematics (theta) *)
    A_mat[3, 1] := 0.0000;  A_mat[3, 2] := 0.1000;  A_mat[3, 3] := 1.0000;  A_mat[3, 4] := 0.0000;  A_mat[3, 5] := 0.0000;   A_mat[3, 6] := 0.0000;
    (* Row 4: Depth kinematics (z) *)
    A_mat[4, 1] := 0.1000;  A_mat[4, 2] := 0.0000;  A_mat[4, 3] := -0.0350; A_mat[4, 4] := 1.0000;  A_mat[4, 5] := 0.0000;   A_mat[4, 6] := 0.0000;
    (* Row 5: VBE Displaced Volume integrator (V_vbe) *)
    A_mat[5, 1] := 0.0000;  A_mat[5, 2] := 0.0000;  A_mat[5, 3] := 0.0000;  A_mat[5, 4] := 0.0000;  A_mat[5, 5] := 1.0000;   A_mat[5, 6] := 0.0000;
    (* Row 6: Moving-mass linear position integrator (x_mass) *)
    A_mat[6, 1] := 0.0000;  A_mat[6, 2] := 0.0000;  A_mat[6, 3] := 0.0000;  A_mat[6, 4] := 0.0000;  A_mat[6, 5] := 0.0000;   A_mat[6, 6] := 1.0000;

    (* Input matrix B_mat (dT = 0.100s) *)
    B_mat[1, 1] := 6.250E1; B_mat[1, 2] := -0.0026;
    B_mat[2, 1] := 0.0000;  B_mat[2, 2] := 1.2250;
    B_mat[3, 1] := 0.0000;  B_mat[3, 2] := 0.0612;
    B_mat[4, 1] := 0.0000;  B_mat[4, 2] := -0.0017;
    B_mat[5, 1] := 0.1000;  B_mat[5, 2] := 0.0000;
    B_mat[6, 1] := 0.0000;  B_mat[6, 2] := 0.1000;

    (* Output matrix C_mat *)
    C_mat[1, 4] := 1.0; (* y1 = z *)
    C_mat[2, 3] := 1.0; (* y2 = theta *)
    C_mat[3, 1] := 1.0; (* y3 = w *)
    C_mat[4, 3] := 1.0; C_mat[4, 1] := -0.2857; (* y4 = gamma = theta - alpha *)

    bMatricesInitialized := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* 4.1 Update Measured State Vector from Filtered Sensor Telemetry *)
x_state[1] := rEstimatedDescentRate_ms;
x_state[2] := rIMU_PitchRate_degs * 0.0174532925;
x_state[3] := rRadPitch;
x_state[4] := rEstimatedDepth_m;
x_state[5] := rVBE_DisplacedVolume_cm3 * 1.0E-6; (* Convert cm3 to m3 *)
x_state[6] := rBatteryLinearPos_mm * 1.0E-3;     (* Convert mm to m *)

(* 4.2 One-Step Ahead State Prediction x_pred = A_mat * x_state + B_mat * u_control *)
x_pred[1] := (A_mat[1,1]*x_state[1]) + (A_mat[1,2]*x_state[2]) + (A_mat[1,3]*x_state[3]) + (A_mat[1,4]*x_state[4]) + (A_mat[1,5]*x_state[5]) + (A_mat[1,6]*x_state[6]) + (B_mat[1,1]*u_control[1]) + (B_mat[1,2]*u_control[2]);
x_pred[2] := (A_mat[2,1]*x_state[1]) + (A_mat[2,2]*x_state[2]) + (A_mat[2,3]*x_state[3]) + (A_mat[2,4]*x_state[4]) + (A_mat[2,5]*x_state[5]) + (A_mat[2,6]*x_state[6]) + (B_mat[2,1]*u_control[1]) + (B_mat[2,2]*u_control[2]);
x_pred[3] := (A_mat[3,1]*x_state[1]) + (A_mat[3,2]*x_state[2]) + (A_mat[3,3]*x_state[3]) + (A_mat[3,4]*x_state[4]) + (A_mat[3,5]*x_state[5]) + (A_mat[3,6]*x_state[6]) + (B_mat[3,1]*u_control[1]) + (B_mat[3,2]*u_control[2]);
x_pred[4] := (A_mat[4,1]*x_state[1]) + (A_mat[4,2]*x_state[2]) + (A_mat[4,3]*x_state[3]) + (A_mat[4,4]*x_state[4]) + (A_mat[4,5]*x_state[5]) + (A_mat[4,6]*x_state[6]) + (B_mat[4,1]*u_control[1]) + (B_mat[4,2]*u_control[2]);
x_pred[5] := (A_mat[5,1]*x_state[1]) + (A_mat[5,2]*x_state[2]) + (A_mat[5,3]*x_state[3]) + (A_mat[5,4]*x_state[4]) + (A_mat[5,5]*x_state[5]) + (A_mat[5,6]*x_state[6]) + (B_mat[5,1]*u_control[1]) + (B_mat[5,2]*u_control[2]);
x_pred[6] := (A_mat[6,1]*x_state[1]) + (A_mat[6,2]*x_state[2]) + (A_mat[6,3]*x_state[3]) + (A_mat[6,4]*x_state[4]) + (A_mat[6,5]*x_state[5]) + (A_mat[6,6]*x_state[6]) + (B_mat[6,1]*u_control[1]) + (B_mat[6,2]*u_control[2]);


(* ============================================================================================== *)
(* SECTION 5: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) REFINED QUADRATIC COST APPROXIMATION                 *)
(* ============================================================================================== *)
(*
  At 6,000 meters depth, pumping hydraulic fluid against 600 bar hydrostatic pressure consumes
  vast amounts of battery energy (~25 to 40 Watts). 
  The MPC cost function penalizes both trajectory tracking errors and hydraulic pumping work:
  J = SUM_{k=1..5} [ Q_z * (z_k - z_ref)^2 + Q_theta * (theta_k - theta_ref)^2 + 
                     R_pump * P_ambient * |Q_pump| + R_mass * v_mass^2 ] + P_z * (z_5 - z_ref)^2
*)

rBestCost := 1.0E9;
iBestCandidateIdx := 3; (* Default candidate = neutral hold *)

(* Evaluate candidate control vector combinations *)
IF (iCurrentFlightState >= 30) AND (iCurrentFlightState <= 90) THEN
    (* Candidate Evaluation Loop 1: Hold Neutral *)
    rCostValue := (rWeight_Pitch * (x_state[3] - (rTargetGlideSlope_deg * 0.0174532925)) * (x_state[3] - (rTargetGlideSlope_deg * 0.0174532925))) + 
                  (rWeight_Depth * (x_state[4] - rTargetApogeeDepth_m) * 0.0001);
    IF rCostValue < rBestCost THEN
        rBestCost := rCostValue;
        iBestCandidateIdx := 3;
    END_IF;

    (* Candidate Evaluation 2: Pitch Aft (Nose Up) + Positive Buoyancy Pulse *)
    rCostValue := (rWeight_Pitch * ((x_state[3] + 0.05) - (rTargetGlideSlope_deg * 0.0174532925)) * ((x_state[3] + 0.05) - (rTargetGlideSlope_deg * 0.0174532925))) + 
                  (rWeight_PumpEnergy * (rVotedPressure_bar * 1.0E5) * ABS(rCandidatePumpRates[5])) + 
                  (rWeight_MassSlew * rCandidateMassSpeeds[5] * rCandidateMassSpeeds[5]);
    IF rCostValue < rBestCost THEN
        rBestCost := rCostValue;
        iBestCandidateIdx := 5;
    END_IF;

    (* Candidate Evaluation 3: Pitch Forward (Nose Down) + Gravity Bleed *)
    rCostValue := (rWeight_Pitch * ((x_state[3] - 0.05) - (rTargetGlideSlope_deg * 0.0174532925)) * ((x_state[3] - 0.05) - (rTargetGlideSlope_deg * 0.0174532925))) + 
                  (rWeight_MassSlew * rCandidateMassSpeeds[1] * rCandidateMassSpeeds[1]);
    IF rCostValue < rBestCost THEN
        rBestCost := rCostValue;
        iBestCandidateIdx := 1;
    END_IF;

    (* Assign Optimal Receding Horizon Controls *)
    u_control[1] := rCandidatePumpRates[iBestCandidateIdx];
    u_control[2] := rCandidateMassSpeeds[iBestCandidateIdx];
ELSE
    u_control[1] := 0.0;
    u_control[2] := 0.0;
END_IF;


(* ============================================================================================== *)
(* SECTION 6: VARIABLE BUOYANCY HYDRAULIC ENGINE 600-BAR PISTON GOVERNOR                          *)
(* ============================================================================================== *)
(*
  Translates MPC / FSM buoyancy commands into physical hydraulic pump motor PWM speed,
  high-pressure isolation valve gate signals, and solenoid bleed valve modulation.
*)

(* 6.1 Piston Linear Position Setpoint Calculation [mm] *)
(* Convert target VBE displacement volume [cm3] into piston travel stroke [mm] *)
rHydraulicPistonDemand_mm := (rVBE_DisplacedVolume_cm3 / c_VBE_PistonArea_cm2) * 10.0;
IF rHydraulicPistonDemand_mm < 0.0 THEN rHydraulicPistonDemand_mm := 0.0; END_IF;
IF rHydraulicPistonDemand_mm > c_VBE_MaxStroke_mm THEN rHydraulicPistonDemand_mm := c_VBE_MaxStroke_mm; END_IF;

(* 6.2 Closed-Loop Hydraulic Position Tracking *)
IF (rHydraulicPistonDemand_mm - rHydraulicPistonPos_mm) > 2.0 THEN
    (* Pumping Phase: Expand external bladder against ambient 600 bar hydrostatic pressure *)
    bHydraulicIsolValveOpen := TRUE;
    bHydraulicBleedValveOpen := FALSE;

    (* Modulate brushless pump motor speed up to rated 2800 RPM based on stroke deficit *)
    rHydraulicPumpSpeedCmd_rpm := 600.0 + ((rHydraulicPistonDemand_mm - rHydraulicPistonPos_mm) * 120.0);
    IF rHydraulicPumpSpeedCmd_rpm > c_MaxPumpSpeed_rpm THEN
        rHydraulicPumpSpeedCmd_rpm := c_MaxPumpSpeed_rpm;
    END_IF;

    (* Hydraulic Electrical Power Consumption Estimate: P = Delta_P * Flow / efficiency *)
    rHydraulicPower_Watts := (rVotedPressure_bar * 1.0E5) * 
                             (c_VBE_PistonArea_cm2 * 1.0E-4 * (rHydraulicPumpSpeedCmd_rpm / 60.0) * 0.001) / 0.65;
    tPumpRunTimer_s := tPumpRunTimer_s + rCycleTime_s;
    dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0002; (* Hydraulic Pump Active *)

ELSIF (rHydraulicPistonPos_mm - rHydraulicPistonDemand_mm) > 2.0 THEN
    (* Bleed Phase: Zero-pump power! Ambient hydrostatic pressure pushes oil back to internal tank *)
    rHydraulicPumpSpeedCmd_rpm := 0.0;
    bHydraulicIsolValveOpen := TRUE;
    bHydraulicBleedValveOpen := TRUE;
    rHydraulicPower_Watts := 1.2; (* Solenoid valve holding power only [W] *)
    tBleedValveTimer_s := tBleedValveTimer_s + rCycleTime_s;
    dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0004; (* Hydraulic Bleed Active *)
    dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord AND 16#FFFF_FFFD; (* Pump Inactive *)

ELSE
    (* Deadband Hold Phase: Hydraulically locked, both valves sealed to conserve battery *)
    rHydraulicPumpSpeedCmd_rpm := 0.0;
    bHydraulicIsolValveOpen := FALSE;
    bHydraulicBleedValveOpen := FALSE;
    rHydraulicPower_Watts := 0.0;
    dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord AND 16#FFFF_FFF9; (* Pump and Bleed Inactive *)
END_IF;

(* 6.3 Hydraulic Overpressure & Over-Current Safety Interlocks *)
IF rHydraulicSystemPress_bar > c_MaxHydraulicPressure_bar THEN
    rHydraulicPumpSpeedCmd_rpm := 0.0;
    bHydraulicIsolValveOpen := FALSE;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0010; (* Hydraulic Overpressure Trip *)
END_IF;

IF rHydraulicMotorCurrent_A > 18.5 THEN
    rHydraulicPumpSpeedCmd_rpm := 0.0;
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0020; (* Hydraulic Motor Over-Current *)
END_IF;


(* ============================================================================================== *)
(* SECTION 7: MOVING-MASS BATTERY PITCH & ROLL LEAD-SCREW MECHATRONIC GOVERNOR                    *)
(* ============================================================================================== *)
(*
  Controls internal battery carriage translation (longitudinal pitch) and rotation (eccentric roll).
  Converts target glide slope theta and heading error psi into precision lead-screw positions.
*)

(* 7.1 Pitch Angle Closed-Loop PI Governor *)
rPitchLoopError_deg := rTargetGlideSlope_deg - rIMU_Pitch_deg;

(* Anti-windup clamping on pitch integral accumulator *)
IF ABS(rPitchLoopError_deg) < 10.0 THEN
    rPitchLoopIntegral := rPitchLoopIntegral + (rPitchLoopError_deg * rCycleTime_s);
    IF rPitchLoopIntegral > 45.0 THEN rPitchLoopIntegral := 45.0; END_IF;
    IF rPitchLoopIntegral < -45.0 THEN rPitchLoopIntegral := -45.0; END_IF;
ELSE
    rPitchLoopIntegral := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Battery target longitudinal position demand [mm] (-120.0 to +120.0 mm) *)
rBatteryPitchDriveCmd_mm := (rPitchLoopError_deg * 4.25) + (rPitchLoopIntegral * 0.35);

(* Mechanical stroke limit constraints *)
IF rBatteryPitchDriveCmd_mm > 115.0 THEN rBatteryPitchDriveCmd_mm := 115.0; END_IF;
IF rBatteryPitchDriveCmd_mm < -115.0 THEN rBatteryPitchDriveCmd_mm := -115.0; END_IF;

(* Commanded battery linear speed demand [mm/s] with slew-rate limiting *)
rBatteryLinearSpeedCmd_mms := ABS(rBatteryPitchDriveCmd_mm - rBatteryLinearPos_mm) * 1.5;
IF rBatteryLinearSpeedCmd_mms > c_MaxBatterySpeed_mms THEN
    rBatteryLinearSpeedCmd_mms := c_MaxBatterySpeed_mms;
END_IF;

(* 7.2 Eccentric Roll Heading Compensation Governor (Zero-Drag Banking Turns) *)
rRollLoopError_deg := rTargetHeading_deg - rIMU_Heading_deg;
(* Normalize heading error to [-180.0, +180.0] degrees *)
IF rRollLoopError_deg > 180.0 THEN rRollLoopError_deg := rRollLoopError_deg - 360.0; END_IF;
IF rRollLoopError_deg < -180.0 THEN rRollLoopError_deg := rRollLoopError_deg + 360.0; END_IF;

(* Proportional roll angle demand (-45.0 to +45.0 deg) *)
rBatteryRollDriveCmd_deg := rRollLoopError_deg * 0.45;
IF rBatteryRollDriveCmd_deg > 35.0 THEN rBatteryRollDriveCmd_deg := 35.0; END_IF;
IF rBatteryRollDriveCmd_deg < -35.0 THEN rBatteryRollDriveCmd_deg := -35.0; END_IF;

(* Slew rate and lead-screw stall protection *)
IF rBatteryLinearCurrent_A > 4.5 THEN
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0040; (* Pitch Ball-Screw Actuator Stall *)
END_IF;

IF rBatteryRollCurrent_A > 3.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0080; (* Roll Eccentric Actuator Stall *)
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================== *)
(* SECTION 8: MULTI-STAGE HADAL & ABYSSAL FLIGHT FINITE STATE MACHINE (CASE)                      *)
(* ============================================================================================== *)
(*
  Controls the complete 6,000-meter saw-tooth yo-yo flight profile through 12 deterministic states.
  Manages energy consumption, hydraulic pressure transitions, bottom altimetry safety boundaries,
  apogee 600-bar turnaround, and failsafe recovery.
*)

(* Edge detection and state transition dwell timer update *)
IF iState = iPrevState THEN
    tStateTimer_s := tStateTimer_s + rCycleTime_s;
ELSE
    tStateTimer_s := 0.0;
    iPrevState := iState;
END_IF;

tMissionClock_s := tMissionClock_s + rCycleTime_s;
iCurrentFlightState := iState;

(* Check high-priority Emergency Abort Interlock *)
IF bEmergencySurfaceCmd OR (rEstimatedDepth_m > 6100.0) OR bInternalHullLeakSensor THEN
    iState := 110; (* Jump immediately to EMERGENCY_SURFACE_ABORT *)
END_IF;

CASE iState OF

    0: (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
       (* STATE 0: COLD_INIT_AND_SYSTEM_SELF_TEST                                               *)
       (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
       bSystemReady := FALSE;
       bMissionActive := FALSE;
       bApogeeReached := FALSE;
       bSurfaceReached := FALSE;
       rHydraulicPumpSpeedCmd_rpm := 0.0;
       bHydraulicIsolValveOpen := FALSE;
       bHydraulicBleedValveOpen := FALSE;
       rBatteryPitchDriveCmd_mm := 0.0;
       rBatteryRollDriveCmd_deg := 0.0;

       (* Verify internal hull dry chamber environment *)
       IF (rInternalAtmPress_mbar > 650.0) AND (rInternalAtmPress_mbar < 1050.0) AND 
          (rInternalHullHumidity_pct < 65.0) AND NOT bInternalHullLeakSensor THEN
           (* Pressure transmitters health sanity check *)
           IF iValidPressureSensorCount >= 2 THEN
               IF bEnable THEN
                   IF bHarborTestMode THEN
                       bSystemReady := TRUE;
                   ELSIF tStateTimer_s > 3.0 THEN
                       bSystemReady := TRUE;
                       iState := 10; (* Transition to Surface Standby *)
                   END_IF;
               END_IF;
           ELSE
               dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0002; (* TMR Initialization Failure *)
           END_IF;
       ELSE
           dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Internal Hull Atmosphere Compromised *)
       END_IF;


    10: (* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 10: SURFACE_STANDBY_AND_COMMUNICATION_TRIM                                     *)
        (* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bMissionActive := FALSE;
        bSurfaceReached := TRUE;
        bDescentPhaseActive := FALSE;
        bAscentPhaseActive := FALSE;

        (* Trim vehicle for maximum satellite antenna exposure: tail up, nose pitched down *)
        rBatteryPitchDriveCmd_mm := 45.0; (* Forward mass shift *)
        rBatteryRollDriveCmd_deg := 0.0;
        rHydraulicPistonDemand_mm := c_VBE_MaxStroke_mm; (* Bladder full expansion for positive float *)

        (* Wait for operator / satellite mission start pulse *)
        IF bMissionStart AND bEnable THEN
            bMissionActive := TRUE;
            bSurfaceReached := FALSE;
            iDiveCycleCounter := iDiveCycleCounter + 1;
            iState := 20; (* Initiate Dive *)
        END_IF;


    20: (* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 20: DIVE_INITIATION_BALLAST_BLEED                                              *)
        (* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* Purge external bladder to achieve negative buoyancy; drive battery forward for steep dive *)
        bMissionActive := TRUE;
        bDescentPhaseActive := TRUE;
        bAscentPhaseActive := FALSE;
        bApogeeReached := FALSE;

        rBatteryPitchDriveCmd_mm := 65.0; (* Move mass forward to induce -25 deg pitch *)
        rBatteryRollDriveCmd_deg := 0.0;

        (* Command zero volume: open bleed valve to dump oil into internal tank *)
        rHydraulicPistonDemand_mm := 0.0;
        bHydraulicBleedValveOpen := TRUE;
        bHydraulicIsolValveOpen := TRUE;
        rHydraulicPumpSpeedCmd_rpm := 0.0;

        (* Check dive entry progress: vehicle sinks below surface wave zone *)
        IF (rEstimatedDepth_m > 15.0) AND (rEstimatedDescentRate_ms < -0.12) THEN
            iState := 30; (* Enter Epipelagic Shallow Glide *)
        ELSIF tStateTimer_s > 300.0 THEN
            (* Dive initiation timeout: unable to submerge *)
            dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0080; (* Dive Submersion Failure Timeout *)
            iState := 10; (* Return to surface standby *)
        END_IF;


    30: (* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 30: SHALLOW_GLIDE_DESCENT_0_TO_500M (EPIPELAGIC LAYER)                         *)
        (* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* Traverse thermocline where density gradients are steepest. Active pitch/roll steering *)
        bDescentPhaseActive := TRUE;
        rBatteryPitchDriveCmd_mm := 52.0; (* Nominal descent pitch position *)
        rHydraulicPistonDemand_mm := 10.0; (* Maintain slight negative buoyancy buffer *)

        (* Check transition depth to Mesopelagic zone *)
        IF rEstimatedDepth_m >= 500.0 THEN
            iState := 40; (* Enter Mesopelagic Descent *)
        END_IF;


    40: (* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 40: MESOPELAGIC_GLIDE_DESCENT_500_TO_2000M                                      *)
        (* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* Hydrostatic pressure reaches 200 bar; hull compression begins to increase sink rate *)
        bDescentPhaseActive := TRUE;

        (* Fine-trim battery position to regulate steady glide slope *)
        rBatteryPitchDriveCmd_mm := 48.0;

        (* Monitor in-situ net buoyancy: if hull compression causes excessive sink speed, trim VBE *)
        IF rEstimatedDescentRate_ms < -0.42 THEN
            (* Bleed/pump micro-trim to counteract hull compression runaway *)
            rHydraulicPistonDemand_mm := 25.0;
        ELSE
            rHydraulicPistonDemand_mm := 15.0;
        END_IF;

        IF rEstimatedDepth_m >= 2000.0 THEN
            iState := 50; (* Enter Abyssal Glide Descent *)
        END_IF;


    50: (* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 50: ABYSSAL_GLIDE_DESCENT_TRIM_2000_TO_5800M (BATHYPELAGIC / ABYSSAL)          *)
        (* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* Extreme hydrostatic pressure (200 to 580 bar). Deep ocean current dead-reckoning *)
        bDescentPhaseActive := TRUE;
        rBatteryPitchDriveCmd_mm := 45.0;
        rHydraulicPistonDemand_mm := 20.0;

        (* Seabed Proximity & Altimetry Safety Boundary Check *)
        IF (rDepthSounderAlt_m > 0.5) AND (rDepthSounderAlt_m <= 250.0) THEN
            iState := 60; (* Seabed acquired: transition to bottom approach *)
        ELSIF rEstimatedDepth_m >= 5800.0 THEN
            iState := 60; (* Depth limit approach reached *)
        END_IF;


    60: (* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 60: ABYSSAL_APPROACH_DVL_BOTTOM_LOCK_AND_DECEL_5800_TO_6000M                   *)
        (* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* DVL acquires 4-beam acoustic bottom lock. Decelerate vehicle to prevent seabed impact *)
        bDescentPhaseActive := TRUE;

        (* Pull up glide angle: move battery mass toward neutral (0 mm) to reduce pitch *)
        rBatteryPitchDriveCmd_mm := 15.0;
        rHydraulicPistonDemand_mm := 35.0; (* Counteract sink speed *)

        (* Trigger apogee turnaround if minimum altitude or target depth reached *)
        IF (rDepthSounderAlt_m > 0.5) AND (rDepthSounderAlt_m <= rMinSeabedClearance_m) THEN
            bApogeeReached := TRUE;
            iState := 70; (* Turnaround at altitude limit *)
        ELSIF rEstimatedDepth_m >= rTargetApogeeDepth_m THEN
            bApogeeReached := TRUE;
            iState := 70; (* Turnaround at commanded target depth *)
        ELSIF rEstimatedDepth_m >= 5980.0 THEN
            bApogeeReached := TRUE;
            iState := 70; (* Absolute hard 6,000m envelope safety limit *)
        END_IF;


    70: (* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 70: APOGEE_BOTTOM_INFLECTION_600BAR_HYDRAULIC_INVERSION                        *)
        (* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (*
          CRITICAL APOGEE INFLECTION:
          At 6,000m (600 bar), the glider must stop descending and establish positive buoyancy.
          1. Shift battery mass full aft (x_mass = -75.0 mm) to pitch nose up (+25 deg).
          2. Run high-pressure axial pump to inject 850 cm3 oil into external bladder against 600 bar.
        *)
        bDescentPhaseActive := FALSE;
        bAscentPhaseActive := TRUE;
        bApogeeReached := TRUE;

        (* Pitch Nose Up *)
        rBatteryPitchDriveCmd_mm := -75.0;

        (* High-Pressure Pumping Command (Piston target = 85.0 mm => 850 cm3 expansion) *)
        rHydraulicPistonDemand_mm := 85.0;

        (* Monitor upward ascent transition: wait until positive climb rate is verified *)
        IF (rEstimatedDescentRate_ms > 0.10) AND (rIMU_Pitch_deg > 15.0) THEN
            iState := 80; (* Steady Abyssal Climb established *)
        ELSIF tStateTimer_s > 450.0 THEN
            (* Turnaround pumping taking too long: trigger emergency ascent *)
            dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Apogee Inversion Timeout *)
            iState := 110;
        END_IF;


    80: (* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 80: ABYSSAL_GLIDE_ASCENT_6000_TO_2000M                                         *)
        (* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* Steady climb through cold abyssal water. Steer toward surface GPS target heading *)
        bAscentPhaseActive := TRUE;
        rBatteryPitchDriveCmd_mm := -55.0; (* Maintain +22 deg climb slope *)
        rHydraulicPistonDemand_mm := 80.0; (* Maintain positive buoyancy *)

        IF rEstimatedDepth_m <= 2000.0 THEN
            iState := 90; (* Enter Upper Water Column Ascent *)
        END_IF;


    90: (* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 90: UPPER_WATER_COLUMN_ASCENT_2000_TO_50M                                      *)
        (* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* As water warms and pressure drops, hull expands and net positive buoyancy increases *)
        bAscentPhaseActive := TRUE;
        rBatteryPitchDriveCmd_mm := -50.0;
        rHydraulicPistonDemand_mm := 75.0;

        IF rEstimatedDepth_m <= 50.0 THEN
            iState := 100; (* Approach Ocean Surface *)
        END_IF;


    100: (* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
         (* STATE 100: SURFACE_BUOYANCY_EMERGENCE_AND_COMMUNICATION                             *)
         (* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
         (* Full bladder expansion to elevate antenna mast out of waves for satellite comms *)
         bAscentPhaseActive := FALSE;
         bSurfaceReached := TRUE;

         rBatteryPitchDriveCmd_mm := 50.0; (* Pitch down tail-up to point antenna skyward *)
         rBatteryRollDriveCmd_deg := 0.0;

         (* Full pump displacement to maximum stroke (150.0 mm => 1500 cm3 expansion) *)
         rHydraulicPistonDemand_mm := c_VBE_MaxStroke_mm;

         IF rEstimatedDepth_m <= rSafeSurfaceMargin_m THEN
             dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0008; (* Surface Communication Ready *)
             IF tStateTimer_s > 180.0 THEN
                 (* Surface dwell cycle completed *)
                 IF bMissionStart THEN
                     iState := 20; (* Repeat yo-yo dive profile *)
                 ELSE
                     iState := 10; (* Return to surface standby *)
                 END_IF;
             END_IF;
         END_IF;


    110: (* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
         (* STATE 110: EMERGENCY_SURFACE_ABORT                                                  *)
         (* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
         (*
           MAXIMUM EMERGENCY ASCENT SEQUENCE:
           1. Drive battery carriage to mechanical full-aft limit (-115 mm) for maximum nose up.
           2. Command maximum hydraulic pump displacement to inflate bladder.
           3. Fire electrolytic galvanic burn-wire to drop 5.0 kg emergency ballast (+49.0 N lift).
         *)
         bEmergencyAscentTriggered := TRUE;
         bMissionActive := FALSE;
         bDescentPhaseActive := FALSE;
         bAscentPhaseActive := TRUE;

         rBatteryPitchDriveCmd_mm := -115.0; (* Full aft *)
         rBatteryRollDriveCmd_deg := 0.0;
         rHydraulicPistonDemand_mm := c_VBE_MaxStroke_mm;

         (* Energize galvanic burn wire to release drop-weight *)
         IF NOT bDropWeightBurnWireFired THEN
             tBurnWireTimer_s := tBurnWireTimer_s + rCycleTime_s;
             IF tBurnWireTimer_s > 10.0 THEN
                 bDropWeightBurnWireFired := TRUE;
                 dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0010; (* Emergency Ballast Jettisoned *)
             END_IF;
         END_IF;

         (* Once surface is breached, enter failsafe beacon containment *)
         IF rEstimatedDepth_m <= rSafeSurfaceMargin_m THEN
             iState := 120;
         END_IF;


    120: (* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
         (* STATE 120: FAILSAFE_CONTAINMENT_AND_BEACON_DRIFT                                    *)
         (* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
         (* Shut down all mechatronic actuators to conserve emergency satellite beacon power *)
         rHydraulicPumpSpeedCmd_rpm := 0.0;
         bHydraulicIsolValveOpen := FALSE;
         bHydraulicBleedValveOpen := FALSE;
         bSurfaceReached := TRUE;
         dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0020; (* Failsafe Beacon Active *)

END_CASE;


(* ============================================================================================== *)
(* SECTION 9: ALARM AGGREGATION, STATUS WORD PACKING & GRACEFUL DEGRADATION                       *)
(* ============================================================================================== *)

(* 9.1 Global Alarm Word 1: Critical System Safety Trips *)
IF (rEstimatedDepth_m > 6200.0) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0010; (* Crush Depth Envelope Exceeded *)
END_IF;

IF bInternalHullLeakSensor THEN
